Hmmm. Which floor has the Everything Bundle? Is it… P? No, that’s probably parking. Or maybe penthouse? I’m just looking for the floor with all the foils and all the non-foils from the Inside an Elevator Superdrop. You don’t know? It’s the floor with an amazing selection of cards with incredible art in foil and non-foil. I just don’t know which floor… Maybe I’ll just hit all the buttons and see…
